(Mauni)_Viśveśvara_Bhaṭṭa
alias Gāgā Bhaṭṭa (C. 1620-85), preceptor of the (a. of Prayogasāra Hpr. III. 191), son of Dinakara alias Divākara Bhaṭṭa, grandson of Rāmakṛṣṇa Bhaṭṭa an. Umā, great grandson of Nārāyaṇa, great great grandson of Rāmeśvara, nephew of Kamalākara (1612 C.E.). He was close associated with Chatrapati Śivāji. He officiated a. the latter's, coronation (1674 C.E.). He had to disturb his ascetic life a. the request of Śivāji, see Alwar 117.
Q. in Kavīndracandrodaya. See Tattvabindu, Ann. Uni. Skt. Ser. Intro. p. 133. See under Bhaṭṭa Gāgā.
